findings.title: Public blob access enabled on 1200 storage accounts
findings.description: 1200 storage accounts in this subscription allow public blob access. This is one aggregated finding (one finding class, many affected instances), not one finding per account.
findings.attack_vector: Anonymous enumeration of public containers -> unauthenticated data read.
findings.risk: Bulk data exposure across the estate; trivially discoverable by automated scanners.
findings.recommendation: Set 'allowBlobPublicAccess' = false at the account level and audit container ACLs. Apply via Azure Policy to prevent regression across all current and future accounts.

evidence.summary: 1200 accounts returned where properties.allowBlobPublicAccess == true (paged, >1,000 rows).
Representative: stscale0000 (westus2) allows public blob access.
Representative: stscale0001 allows public blob access.

defender_for_cloud: Storage account public access should be disallowed

findings.title: Management port (RDP 3389) open to the internet
findings.description: An NSG permits inbound RDP from 0.0.0.0/0 to a jump host. Single-instance (N=1) finding.
findings.attack_vector: Internet RDP brute force -> initial access on the jump host.
findings.risk: Direct foothold into the management network.
findings.recommendation: Restrict the rule source to a bastion/known admin range or move to Azure Bastion.

evidence.summary: nsg-jump rule allows Inbound Allow 3389 from source *.

findings.title: Public storage exfil pivots to a privileged identity
findings.description: A specific public storage account (one instance of the aggregated AZ-STOR-001 finding) leaks a deployment credential that maps to a privileged identity, chaining to a Critical end state.
findings.attack_vector: Public blob read -> leaked credential -> privileged role -> subscription control.
findings.risk: Aggregated-finding instance becomes the entry point of a Critical chain.
findings.recommendation: Disable public access on the named account first; rotate the leaked credential.

evidence.summary: Path entry uses the specific account stscale0007, an instance of AZ-STOR-001.

attack_path: Leaked deployment credential in a public container
